# @lynn123411/opencode-deepseek-search

DeepSeek Search provider for OpenCode's built-in `websearch` tool. It calls
[DeepSeek Search API](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/search) and returns
the results as normal `websearch` results.

## Install

```bash
opencode plugin add @lynn123411/opencode-deepseek-search
```

## Configure the API key

Set the key in the environment OpenCode runs in:

```bash
export DEEPSEEK_API_KEY="sk-..."
```

Or pass it through plugin options in `opencode.json`:

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "@lynn123411/opencode-deepseek-search",
      "options": {
        "apiKey": "sk-..."
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

You can also use `keyFile` to point at a file that contains the key.

Do not commit the key to a repository.

## Select the provider

The plugin registers the provider id `deepseek`. If no websearch provider is
selected yet, it sets `deepseek` as the default. To force it, add:

```json
{
  "websearch": {
    "provider": "deepseek"
  }
}
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | string | — | DeepSeek API key. Prefer `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`. |
| `keyFile` | string | — | File containing the key. |
| `setDefault` | boolean | `true` | Set `deepseek` as default when no provider is selected. |
| `count` | number | `8` | Results per search, 1–50. |

## Cost

DeepSeek Search is billed per successful request: **$0.75 per 1,000 calls**
(about $0.00075 per search). Failed requests and empty results are not billed.
See the [Search & Fetch guide](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/search).

## Notes

- Requires OpenCode 2.2.x and the `@opencode/plugin` API.
- The plugin only registers a websearch provider; it does not change models or
  other OpenCode settings.
- If DeepSeek returns HTTP 402 (no balance) or 429 (rate limit), the search fails
  with the provider's error message instead of silently returning no results.
